sections_target.text: Procedures to be Carried Out — First: General Procedures

rows: Verify the fire truck's trial operation and that it is serviceable.
Verify that the siren is working.
Verify that the flasher is working.
Second: Water Fire-Extinguishing System
Carefully verify the soundness of the foam-liquid tank and carry out the necessary maintenance when required.
Replace the expired foam liquid with fresh foam liquid valid for five years and verify that the foam-liquid level is ideal.
Tightly close the foam-liquid refilling opening.
Record the refilling date and the validity period on a sticker and place it in a visible location on the foam tank body.
Verify the serviceability of the foam system accessories — the valves, hoses and nozzles for the foam liquid — and verify the serviceability of the means of indicating (gauge) the foam-liquid level.
Third: Fire Truck Accessories
Verify the presence of fire-resistant suits with their accessories.
Verify the presence of a breathing apparatus and that it is serviceable.
Verify the presence of rescue equipment (ropes – shears – crowbar – axe ...).
Verify that the fire truck's ladder is serviceable.

Introduction
This document sets out the steps of the 5-yearly inspection of the foam fire-extinguishing system used on fire trucks.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. El-Sayed Ahmed El-Desouky, tested by Eng. Osama Ismail El-Mashad and reviewed by Eng. Mostafa El-Nady Abdel Rahman.
It was endorsed by Eng. Farouk Awad Ali, Head of the Talkha Power Station Sector.
It was reviewed and approved by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Khater, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil Ahmed, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's coordinator for the Maintenance Procedures Information System, and documented by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet – safety shoes – overalls – gloves ...).

Procedures to be Carried Out — First: General Procedures
1. | Verify the fire truck's trial operation and that it is serviceable.
2. | Verify that the siren is working.
3. | Verify that the flasher is working.
Second: Water Fire-Extinguishing System
1. | Carefully verify the soundness of the foam-liquid tank and carry out the necessary maintenance when required.
2. | Replace the expired foam liquid with fresh foam liquid valid for five years and verify that the foam-liquid level is ideal.
3. | Tightly close the foam-liquid refilling opening.
4. | Record the refilling date and the validity period on a sticker and place it in a visible location on the foam tank body.
5. | Verify the serviceability of the foam system accessories — the valves, hoses and nozzles for the foam liquid — and verify the serviceability of the means of indicating (gauge) the foam-liquid level.
Third: Fire Truck Accessories
1. | Verify the presence of fire-resistant suits with their accessories.
2. | Verify the presence of a breathing apparatus and that it is serviceable.
3. | Verify the presence of rescue equipment (ropes – shears – crowbar – axe ...).
4. | Verify that the fire truck's ladder is serviceable.
